definitions.explanation: A naturally occurring fossil fuel consisting mainly of methane, used for heating, cooking, and electricity generation.

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of natural gas went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}ガス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This region is rich in natural gas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天然|てんねん}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}っている→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。
examples.english: Japan relies on imports for most of its natural gas.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ (natural) + ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧ (gas). Japan imports large quantities of liquefied natural gas (LNG / {液化|えきか}{天然|てんねん}ガス). Natural gas is also used in household cooking and heating via city gas (⟦{都市|とし}ガス→都市ガス：22713_toshigasu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: natural gas imports
- {液化|えきか}{天然|てんねん}ガス (LNG): liquefied natural gas
- {天然|てんねん}ガス{田|でん}: natural gas field
- {天然|てんねん}ガス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧: natural gas extraction
